variables.name: PASS_MINLEN
variables.description: Minimum pam_passwdqc password length. The check fails below this.

variables.name: PASS_MAX_DAYS
variables.description: Maximum passwordtime in days. The check fails above this.

variables.name: PASS_WARN_AGE
variables.description: Minimum warnpassword in days. The check fails below this.

variables.name: SUDO_TIMESTAMP_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Maximum sudo timestamp_timeout in minutes. The check fails above this. A missing timeout still passes.

variables.name: LOGIN_GRACE_TIME
variables.description: Maximum sshd LoginGraceTime in seconds. The check fails outside 1 and this value.

variables.name: SSH_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Comma-separated sshd LogLevel values that pass. Remediation applies the first value.

variables.name: MAX_AUTH_TRIES
variables.description: Maximum sshd MaxAuthTries. The check fails above this.

variables.name: MAX_SESSIONS
variables.description: Maximum sshd MaxSessions. The check fails above this.

variables.name: MAX_STARTUPS
variables.description: Maximum sshd MaxStartups as start:rate:full. Each field on the host must be at or below the matching field.

variables.name: SSH_PERMIT_ROOT
variables.description: Comma-separated sshd PermitRootLogin values that pass. Remediation applies the first value.

variables.name: SYSCTL_ASLR
variables.description: Required kern.elf64.aslr.enable value.

variables.name: SYSCTL_ACCEPT_SOURCEROUTE
variables.description: Required net.inet.ip.accept_sourceroute value.

variables.name: SYSCTL_TCP_SYNCOOKIES
variables.description: Required net.inet.tcp.syncookies value.

variables.name: SYSCTL_ACCEPT_RTADV
variables.description: Required net.inet6.ip6.accept_rtadv value.

variables.name: MODE_LOADER
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for loader.conf. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_MOTD
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /etc/motd. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_ISSUE
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /etc/issue. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_CRON_ALLOW
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /var/cron/allow. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_AT_ALLOW
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /var/at/at.allow. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_SSHD_CONFIG
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /etc/ssh/sshd_config. A stricter mode passes. Remediation keeps mode 600 unless this ceiling is stricter.

variables.name: MODE_SSH_HOSTKEY
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for SSH private host keys. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_SSH_HOSTKEY_PUB
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for SSH public host keys. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_VAR_LOG
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /var/log/messages, cron, auth.log, and maillog. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_AUDIT_LOG_DIR
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for the audit log directory. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_AUDIT_LOGS
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for audit log files. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_PASSWD
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /etc/passwd. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_GROUP
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /etc/group. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_MASTER_PASSWD
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /etc/master.passwd. A stricter mode passes.

variables.name: MODE_SHELLS
variables.description: Maximum octal mode for /etc/shells. A stricter mode passes.
